title: Released today! My Customizable mech based shoot em up.
author: crumbaker
selftext:
[https://store.steampowered.com/app/5483280/Metal\_Wayfarer/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5483280/Metal_Wayfarer/)

I always wanted to have more customization in games like these. Was a huge fan of the Xmen and Ninja turtles beat em ups when I was a kid.

Tons of parts to choose from. You find schematics for within the levels to build the way you like. Kick ass and take back the island!

Just built with Opus 5.5. No mcp's just explained what I wanted in great detail, started small with characters, then levels and gameplay. Took about a small books worth of prompts to get what you see here.
